title: Pizza Bianca
subtitle: with broccoli and potato
description: A tray pizza with a creamy white sauce, mozzarella, sliced potatoes and broccoli on homemade dough. Finished with Manchego.

steps.text: Mix half a cup of the water with the yeast until dissolved. Set aside for a few minutes, until puffy and airy.
In a large bowl, mix the flour, sugar and salt. Add the yeast mixture, the remaining water and the olive oil, and knead to a uniform dough.
Transfer the dough to a greased bowl and cover. After 20 minutes, take the dough out and knead lightly. Cover and rest for another 20 minutes. Repeat twice more.
Make the white sauce: bring all the sauce ingredients to the boil in a small pot, stirring. Reduce the heat and cook for about half an hour, stirring occasionally, until thickened. Cool slightly.
Preheat the oven to 250°C and line a rectangular tray with baking paper.

Divide the dough into 3 equal parts. Roll each out on a floured surface into a rectangle (or round) and place in the tray. Pour over the sauce, scatter with mozzarella, potato and broccoli, and bake for about 20 minutes, until deeply golden and bubbling.
Remove from the oven, sprinkle with Manchego and serve.
